videos.title: 3D Printing Started With a Toy Frog 🐸 #shorts
videos.description:
In 1988 Scott Crump made a toy frog for his daughter with a hot glue gun full of plastic and candle wax. That idea became FDM, the most common kind of 3D printing. When the key patent expired in 2009, prices fell from around $20,000 to under $1,000.

▶️ Full documentary on my channel: The History of 3D Printing

videos.title: What Happens When You Press Upload? #shorts
videos.description:
One line of code, one LED. In between: a compiler, a bootloader, flash memory, a 16 MHz clock and one single bit in a register called PORT B. This is what really happens inside your Arduino.
